/-- [pv_alib_reference::pop_move_reference]:
    Source: 'move-reference.rs', lines 2:0-5:1

def pop_move_reference
  {T : Type} (v : alloc.vec.Vec T) :
  Result ((Option T) × (alloc.vec.Vec T))
  := do
  let n := alloc.vec.Vec.len v
  if n = 0#usize
  then ok (none, v)
  else
    let i ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_sub n 1#usize)
    let (t, v1) ← alloc.vec.Vec.remove Global v i
    ok (some t, v1)

end PV_AL_MoveBorrow
